text:
Lilia Vu finishes 88th at ISPS HANDA Women's Scottish Open on Sunday, July 26, 2026
By
L. P. TorresLilia Vu finished 88th at the ISPS HANDA Women's Scottish Open, which concluded Sunday, July 26, 2026, on the LPGA Tour.
Vu, a native of Fountain Valley, California, posted a 153 total, 9 over par, for the tournament.
She shot 79 in Round 1 and 74 in Round 2.
Jenny Shin won the title at 279, 9 under par, while A Lim Kim was second at 281, 7 under. Pajaree Anannarukarn finished third at 283, 5 under.
